NCCL-11 : CUDA_GRAPH
Requirements

$CONTENTS

Project Context and Purpose

NCCL provides fast inter-GPU communication for parallel applications.

NVbugs / Jira Tickets

NVBug 12345

Jira NCCL-991

User Experience

NCCL is used through deep learning frameworks or other HPC applications to accelerate GPU-to-GPU communication. It is supposed to be transparent to the user.

Assumptions, constraints and dependencies

None/$TBD

Use Cases

The CUDA graph support in NCCL would allow users to capture NCCL operations (collectives and P2P) with other compute kernels in the same CUDA graph. Simplifying the programming model and reducing the launch times.

Functional Requirements

Support NCCL calls between CUDA graph start/end capture APIs
